title: Settling Undelivered Cash Patronage With the Equity of a Deceased Member
content:
Cash the cooperative declared but never delivered belongs to the member's estate and is settled with the equity under Membership and Patronage Equity.

The difference in question is the cash portions standing on the equity ledger's allocation notices less the cash delivered against them, rounded to two decimal places and never taken below nothing.

**Where notice of death stands recorded.** Where those cash portions are above the cash delivered against them and notice of death stands recorded on the membership, the whole of the difference is carried into the settlement.

**Where no notice of death stands recorded.** Where those cash portions are above the cash delivered and no notice of death stands recorded, the difference is carried in at the share the class's annual revolvement pool fixes, rounded to two decimal places.

**Otherwise.** Nothing is carried in.

## The readings on hypothetical figures

| Cash portions on the notices | Cash delivered | Notice of death recorded | Carried in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3200.00 | 2000.00 | yes | 1200.00 |
| 3200.00 | 2000.00 | no | 1200.00 taken at the class's annual revolvement pool share |
| 2000.00 | 2000.00 | yes | nothing |
| 1800.00 | 2000.00 | yes | nothing |

**On the last two lines.** Cash delivered standing at the cash portions declared, or above them, leaves no difference to carry, and whether notice of death stands recorded does not come into it.
